dedupe_keys.name: totaal potentieel biogas uit gft afval per gemeente gj ha jaar uit reststromen

description: Totaal Potentieel biogas uit GFT-afval per gemeente (GJ/ha.jaar) uit Reststromen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. This map shows the total potential of biogas per municipality in GJ/(ha.year) that can be produced from GFT (vegetables, fruit and garden waste), liquid manure and residual tromen of arable crops per municipality. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Total Potential biogas from FGT waste per municipality (GJ/ha.year) from Residual flows" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Biogas, GFT, Vloeibare mest, reststromen akkerbouw. The listing shows 2022-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
